# Contributing to Down Lane Motion

Thanks for helping make [downlanemotion.com](https://downlanemotion.com) better. The site's source
code is private, so contributing here means reporting, correcting and suggesting - and those are
what shape the site.

## Where things go

- **Issues** are for things that can be acted on: a [bug](https://github.com/PioneerCode/down-lane-motion-community/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml),
  a [data correction](https://github.com/PioneerCode/down-lane-motion-community/issues/new?template=data-correction.yml)
  or a concrete [feature request](https://github.com/PioneerCode/down-lane-motion-community/issues/new?template=feature-request.yml).
- **[Discussions](https://github.com/PioneerCode/down-lane-motion-community/discussions)** are for
  everything else: questions, ideas you're still thinking through, and talking balls and arsenals.
  An idea that takes shape there can become an issue.

## Before you open an issue

1. **Search first.** If it's already been reported, add a 👍 to the issue rather than a "+1"
   comment. Reactions are how requests are ranked; comments that only say "+1" notify everyone
   watching and add nothing to go on.
2. **One thing per issue.** Two bugs, or a bug and an idea, are easier to track and close as two.
3. **Refresh first.** The site updates often. If something looks wrong, reload the page to make
   sure you're on the latest version.

## Good bug reports

Say which page, what you picked (balls, filters, weights), what you saw, and what you expected.
A screenshot usually says more than a paragraph. Include your device and browser - a lot of
layout bugs only happen on a phone, or only in one browser.

## Good data corrections

Every correction needs a **source**: a product page, a spec sheet, or a photo of
the box or the ball. Specs are only changed when they can be checked, so a correction with a link
gets fixed much faster than one without.

For RG, differential and PSA, say which **weight** - they're different at each one.

## Good feature requests

Start with what you're trying to do, not the feature: "I want to know which of my balls to throw
when the lanes break down" is more useful than "add a sort button", because there may be a better
way to answer it than the first one that comes to mind.

## What happens next

New issues are labeled `triage` until they've been looked at. After that:

| Label | Means |
| --- | --- |
| `bug` | Confirmed, and will be fixed. |
| `data` | A spec or ball correction. |
| `enhancement` | A feature request that's being considered. |
| `planned` | Decided on, and coming. |
| `needs info` | Can't go further without more detail - see the latest comment. Closed after 30 days without a reply. |
| `duplicate` | Already reported; follow the linked issue instead. |
| `wontfix` | Won't be done, with the reason in a comment. |

An issue is closed once the fix is live on the site.

## Code of conduct

Everyone here is expected to follow the [code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
